entries.generation_2_intent: Require a predeclared comparator eligibility rule, preserve material comparators considered, and record exclusion reasons.
Make comparator applicability testable and preserve the reason a materially stronger comparator is classified inapplicable.
Separate information parity, opportunity parity, evaluation parity, and resource regime from legitimate algorithmic implementation differences.
Govern tuning opportunity and search-policy symmetry in Task 8 while leaving concrete effort and resource values to Task 9.
Add an explicit evaluator-validity requirement covering identity, version, bias risks, order effects, qualification, cross-checking where material, and limitation reporting.
Make evaluator model, prompt, scoring implementation, provider revision, and material configuration first-class provenance.
Explicitly inherit Task 7 protected-access, freshness, repeated peeking, lineage, disclosure, and invalidation semantics. Do not create a second holdout policy.
Require predeclared benchmark-portfolio, task-sampling, subset, and difficulty-selection rules when those choices affect the claim.
Require dynamic benchmarks to satisfy the same construct, difficulty, provenance, evaluator, leakage, and reproducibility requirements rather than treating dynamism as automatic safety.
Preserve the existing external-service caveats and provenance requirements; Generation 2 should cross-reference them clearly without inventing false exact reproducibility.
Require replication count or outcome-sensitive stopping rules to be frozen before protected results when optional stopping could change the conclusion.
Separate primary-measure and selective-reporting governance from hard-constraint preservation. Do not invent statistical corrections that override Task 6.
Predeclare claim-affecting trajectory categories and classification rules; preserve UNKNOWN or ambiguous cases instead of forcing favorable post-hoc attribution.
Record target-specific engineering, prompts, retrieval, onboarding, and information transfer separately from learned cross-family decision transfer.
Apply strongest-applicable comparator semantics explicitly to adaptation methods and preserve adaptation-baseline tuning and eligibility provenance.
Define rollback evidence as restored relevant state plus protected post-rollback behavior, not successful invocation of a rollback command.
Freeze the resource-comparison regime before protected outcomes while keeping concrete resource definitions and measurements under Task 9.
Define a governed reassessment trigger based on credible evidence that a materially relevant stronger comparator exists, without claiming continuous knowledge of every method.
Require a narrowed claim to preserve the original blocked or unsupported broader claim and its evidence gap.
Trigger additional real-world evaluation from the exact claim and deployment assumptions rather than requiring universal production testing.
Define claim-proportionate independence dimensions and require shared evaluator, code, data, transformation, aggregation, and assumption dependencies to be disclosed.
Use the same new evaluator-validity requirement as AF-005 so evaluation artifacts, grading rules, answer parsing, ordering, and scoring behavior cannot manufacture a comparison advantage.

Make diagnostic anchors, ordinary claim-bearing comparators, and strongest-applicable comparators explicit roles; favorable anchor results must not obscure failure against the required strong comparator.
